brief:
French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot accused Israel's government of displaying "criminal and shameful tolerance" toward settler terrorism in the occupied West Bank, Shehab Wire reported. Barrot's statement came amid escalating attacks on Palestinians and continued confiscation of their land.

The French minister did not specify which incidents prompted his rebuke, but his language reflected growing international concern over settler violence and its role in the broader Palestinian-Israeli conflict.

title: France condemns Israel's tolerance of settler terrorism in occupied West Bank
